series.context:
Prior events (Part 1): At the Daily Days newspaper in Manhattan, Vice President Gustav and assistant Carol investigate the violent gang war of 1930, only to discover records proving the mobsters were aboard the alchemist ship Advena Avis in 1711.
Prior events (Part 2): Inside the Runorata estate, enforcer Gustavo Bagetta reports the killings of Raymond and Jeffrey Genoard to Don Bartolo, unleashing a violent manhunt that ends with the brutal capture of Dallas Genoard.
